name: Fast Healing
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level cleric/oracle 5, druid 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target living creature touched
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw no; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

The subject gains fast healing 2.
